This supports a specific reliability concern, but unknown experimental dates and the absence of a text-prediction comparison prevent using it to settle the October capability imbalance.

These are material counterevidence to a broadly dismissive account of reasoning, but tool-assisted successes on selected problems do not measure the entire claimed capability imbalance.

The study documents substantial errors on adversarial and ambiguous prompts, while also reporting differences among models. The retrieved text does not date the experiments closely enough to treat them as October outcome evidence, and it does not compare these results with next-token prediction.
